chip.description: Sprite generator paired with the 053246, carrying the sprite RAM and the graphics-ROM data path; used on X-Men, The Simpsons, Vendetta, Bucky O'Hare and other 1991-1993 Konami boards.
chip.notes: src/mame/konami/k053246_k053247_k055673.cpp and konamiic.txt in MAME 0.288. The 055673 is the higher-bit-depth alternative in the same socket role.
